sessions.description: TSS 56, IF 0.67, kJ(Cal) 689.  Description: Warm-up 25min build to 65% 2min easy  Main set 8x4min LT1 with 1min easy  8min cool down
TSS 68, IF 0.74, kJ(Cal) 743.  Description: 10 min easy spin 4x1min building to LT2 2min easy 6x30 sec V02 efforts- 30 sec easy Main set 4x(8 mins at LT1, 2mins at LT2, 1 min easy)  7 min cool down

TSS 53, IF 0.69, kJ(Cal) 598.  Description: 10 mins easy 2mins moderate 1min recovery  Main set - BG / low cadence work - the on screen cadence targets are suggestions only (see below)  4x3mins 80% FTP at 60-65rpms 6x2mins 90% FTP at 55-60rpms 2min recoveries throughout  10min CD at mod / high cadence

TSS 18, IF 0.49, kJ(Cal) 311.  Description: Lazy Mountain -2 is 45 minutes of easy, steady effort between 45-55% FTP. Goals: Recovery rides can be used to further your aerobic base by riding very easily when your muscles are already pretty cooked. When recovery is the goal, keep the ride as short as necessary and pull the plug well inside of an hour if effort this low is wearing you down and postponing your recovery.Spin lightly and reasonably quickly, preferably above 85rpm.
